meta.parties: Ibrahim v. Hong Kong and Shanghai Bank

rules.statement: A notice of seizure issued by the Fiscal on a mandate of sequestration does not create an interest in land within the meaning of section 6 (1) of Ordinance No. 21 of 1927, and is void as against a subsequent mortgage registered prior to its registration.
rules.supporting_quote: "A notice of seizure cannot be said to create an interest in land. It is a notice prohibiting the owner of the property from transferring, alienating, or charging the property and all other persons from receiving the same by purchase, gift or otherwise"
